test_title: PYST 11: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 21 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follows/follow from the statements.

**Statements:**

All boxes are squares.

All squares are rectangles.

All rectangles are figures.

**Conclusions:**

I. All boxes are figures.

II. All squares are figures.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ec03c5b7565e0acd3dfe858092571baf63b96d72c3179fa6810b4e9e91a67a75.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All boxes are figures → Follow (As all boxes are squares, all squares are rectangles and all rectangles are figures. As whole boxes comes in squares which whole comes in rectangles which whole comes in figures, therefore all boxes are figures is true.)

II. All squares are figures → Follow (As all squares are rectangles and all rectangles are figures. As whole squares comes in rectangles which whole comes in figures, therefore all squares are figures is true.)

∴ Here, Both conclusions I and II follow.​

Hence, the correct answer is "**Both conclusions I and II follow**"
